subject: Isolation by distance GPS coordinates to XY format conversion?

messages.author: 592e7f03b854d13c
messages.subject: Isolation by distance GPS coordinates to XY format conversion?
parts:
I'm trying to convert GPS coordinates (DD lat and long) into the format to can be used to plot possessions on isolation by distance graph. I found a way to convert GPS coordinates to distance matrix (m or km), but I'm not sure how to use this file since it is a matrix of all distances among all genotypes.

How to convert GPS coordinates to X Y that could be used with gl.ibd directly? I searched on the adegenet website, and example files have GPS coordinates coded as an X Y... I can't find anywhere explanation who to concert my DD lat and long to X Y coordinates.

Thank you for help!

Cheers, Bernd

messages.author: b3d929c6746ca81a
messages.subject: RE: [dartR] Isolation by distance GPS coordinates to XY format conversion?
parts:
Hi Andrew,

 

The order should not matter with gl.map.interactive as the script is looking for the names.

 

In my example on koalas I did not used names and rgdal is expecting it in the order long-lat.

 

If you use a latitude larger than 90 then you get an error. A good test to find out, which order is expected.

 

 

library(rgdal)

canberra <- c(149.13, -35.2809)

hobart <- c(147.3272, -42.8821)

 

And yes probably the slot should be called lonlat to be precise, but due to “older” compatibility requirements I am hesitant to change it.

 

 

Can you send me your coordinates (the first 4 lines and the proj4 you want to have it in), then I can have a look where it goes wrong.

 

Cheers, bernd
